full_judgment:
2. The facts of the case are, that the opposite parties as plaintiffs instituted a suit being Title Suit No. 68 of 1986 in the First Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka for a declaration of their 16 annas title to the suit property being a pond having an area of 8640 acre of CS plot No. 212 of CS Khatian No. 12133 of Mouza Shahar Dhaka; District Dhaka corresponding to RS plot No. 4323 and No. 7396 of RS Khatian No. 6200 of Mouza Sutrapur, PS Sutrapur, District Dhaka. The said suit was instituted on 2nd March, 1986. According to the plaintiffs, the suit property was owned and possessed by late Sadagar whose name is recorded in the CS Khatian. After his death the plaintiffs as his heirs and successors have been owning and possessing the suit property. Due to the difference between the plaintiffs for some indefinite time past the rent was not paid for the suit property and a few days before the institution of the present suit the plaintiffs went to the office of the defendant No. 1 the Circle Officer (Rev.) Sutrapur Circle, Wiseghat, Dhaka for paying rent of the suit property when Defendant No. 1 and members of his staff refused to receive rent for the suit property stating that the suit property belonged to the Government and did not receive any rent from the plaintiffs for the suit property. The plaintiffs found that the suit property is wrongly recorded in the name of the Government in the SA Khatian which requires to be corrected as it has cast cloud over the right, title and ownership of the plaintiffs. According to the plaintiffs, cause of action arose on 4.2.86 when the defendants refused to receive the rent of the suit property. Alleging these the plaintiffs prayed for a declaration to their 16/- annas title in the suit property with costs. 

 3. The defendants in the written statement denied the allegations made in the plaint. The case for the Government (Defendants) is that the suit property (being a tank measuring more than 4 bighas of land) is recorded in the khas khatian not of the Collector, Dhaka. Zamindar Manmatha Bennerjce purchased the estate including the suit tank from the legal heirs of Shyama Sundari Dasya and thereafter Zaminder of Bhagyakul, Gunendur Krishna Roy Bahadur after obtaining a money decree against Monmatha in Money Suit No.34 of 1934 in the First Court of the Subordinate Judge, Dhaka auction purchased the estate of Manmatha including the suit tank in execution of that decree in Money Execution Case No.157 of 1935 aid obtained possession of the same through Court. The Bhagyakul Zamiadars possessed and managed the suit pond as their khas land. After the wholesale acquisition of the Zamindaries thd suit property became the khas land of the Government and the suit property has since been possessed and managed by the Government as khas land. The plaintiff-opposite parties have got no right, title, possession or interest in the suit land and therefore defendant No.1 rightly refused to accept any rent from the plaintiff. By filing the present Title Suit No. 68/1986 in the First Court of Subordinate Judge. Dhaka fraudulently and collusively the plaintiff-opposite parties managed to get a decree in their favour on 27.3.88 practising fraud upon the court and the decree drawn up on 27.3.88.
